claim: Opens a filled sample handoff in one click
sandbox: fresh browser context starts at /, clicks Try it with sample data once, and asserts the demo banner, Nora Ellis, shift note, three medications, and Taken and Held states

claim: Dose changes in the sample demo do not change your real record
sandbox: fresh browser context creates a real medication, changes and resets a demo dose, returns to the real record, and asserts only the real medication remains

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context visits /privacy then /demo, establishes service-worker control, goes offline, reloads /demo, and asserts the sample remains

claim: Medication records stay in this browser; the app creates no account and loads no analytics or code from other sites
sandbox: fresh /demo context records a dose and creates a QR while intercepting every request; asserts no request leaves the product origin and no account control exists
fresh /demo context chooses a readable export and asserts two downloads, the CSV header, and a Metformin row

claim: An optional encrypted backup cannot be opened without its passphrase
sandbox: fresh /demo context exports with a passphrase, asserts a local AES-GCM parcel, then asserts import with a wrong passphrase fails

claim: Creates a local QR handoff that stays until it is hidden or the page closes
sandbox: fresh /demo context creates a browser data:image/png QR and verifies Hide QR and reload both remove it

claim: The QR handoff contains the selected date, current medication list, and dose states in readable form
sandbox: fresh /demo context decodes the QR without a key and compares its date, full active medication list, and dose states with the visible sample

claim: Prints the included eight-medication test fixture on one A4 or Letter page
sandbox: fresh real-record context imports the documented eight-item fixture, invokes print, asserts tools are hidden, and counts exactly one PDF page for A4 and Letter

claim: Printing, QR handoffs, and exports are free
sandbox: fresh /demo context asserts all three tools are enabled and no checkout link exists

claim: Keeps a current medication list with amounts, directions, and times
sandbox: fresh real-record context saves a medication and asserts its amount, direction, and schedule are rendered after reload

claim: Records a dose state and optional caregiver note
sandbox: fresh real-record context marks a scheduled medication Held with a note and asserts both are rendered after reload

claim: Stores your real record in this browser's local database
sandbox: fresh real-record context saves a medication, reloads, and asserts it remains

claim: Records medication list changes in the handoff history
sandbox: fresh real-record context changes a medication amount and time, then asserts the history names both the prior and new medication list

claim: Existing dose history stays visible after the last medication is stopped
sandbox: fresh real-record context adds, marks Held with a note, edits, and stops the only medication; reloads and asserts the dose, note, edit, and stop event remain visible

where: handoff date control and validation message
sandbox: fresh real-record context adds a medication, enters 2099-12-31, asserts the date resets to today with an error, and inspects IndexedDB to assert no future log exists

claim: Delete this record erases the real medication record from this browser
sandbox: fresh real-record context saves a medication, uses Privacy > Delete this record, confirms the named warning, reloads, and asserts an empty real record while the demo sample remains available
